the-danish-prime-minister-s-coarse-langu.precis: The Danish prime minister’s coarse language about migrants has no place in the EU. Mette Frederiksen’s ‘great replacement’ remarks shows how centrist EU leaders have normalised previously shocking ideas With the notable exception of Spain’s Pedro Sánchez, who may soon be out of office, EU leaders appear most united when promoting one clear aim: reinforcing the already heavily guarded borders of Fortress Europe against unwanted migrants. Policymakers who once criticised Donald Trump’s immigration policies as inhumane now enact measures that increasingly resemble Washington’s ugly playbook of ICE home raids, family separations, deportations and offshore detention deals.
